research_question: How do equal-area and road-node-density-adaptive regional grids affect spatial balance, online scalability, and held-out evacuation decision quality?

partition_contract.coordinate_system: local projected-metre approximation used by MapDS
partition_contract.cell_count: Exactly n squared rectangular cells under both modes
partition_contract.topology: Identical row-major indexing and four-neighbour GNN adjacency
partition_contract.equal_area: Equally spaced x and y boundaries over the occupied road-network extent
partition_contract.node_density_adaptive: Empirical OSM road-node quantiles independently define x and y boundaries; dense axis ranges receive narrower cells
partition_contract.density_proxy_limitation: OSM road-node density is an infrastructure-resolution proxy, not resident population density

execution_order: remaining four cities after gate passes
confirmatory_accuracy_design.pairing: Common map, population, candidates, hazard path, pedestrian outcome stream, policy seed, and scenario seed across partition modes
confirmatory_accuracy_design.policy_training: Train a separate policy for every partition mode and grid resolution; never transfer an equal-area checkpoint to an adaptive grid or vice versa
confirmatory_accuracy_design.statistical_model: Paired mode differences with two-way policy-seed/scenario bootstrap within city and equal-city macro averaging
confirmatory_accuracy_design.multiplicity: Holm correction across casualty fraction and restricted mean time to safety
confirmatory_accuracy_design.noninferiority: A decision-quality noninferiority margin must be numerically preregistered before held-out evaluation; this file intentionally does not invent one without domain calibration

claim_policy.geometry_claim: May be made from deterministic node-balance characterization
claim_policy.accuracy_claim: Requires separately trained policies and complete held-out paired city trials
claim_policy.population_claim: Prohibited because the adaptive boundaries use road-node density rather than census or pedestrian density
